articles.title: Trial to begin for man accused in Pearson gold heist
articles.summary: A trial is set to begin today in Brampton, Ont., for a man accused in what investigators have called one of the largest gold heists in Canadian history. The trial comes soon after prosecutors dropped the charges against two other men accused in the case.

articles.title: Watermain break blocks Midland Avenue in Scarborough
articles.summary: A watermain break has shut down Midland Avenue in Scarborough early Monday morning. Toronto Fire have been on the scene on Midland at Kingston Road since 4:20 a.m. and are working to shut off the rush of water. Police say a sinkhole has also formed as a result of the flooding. articles.title: Trial set to begin for man accused in massive gold heist at Toronto’s Pearson airport
articles.summary: BRAMPTON — A trial is set to begin today in Brampton, Ont., for a man accused in what investigators have called one of the largest gold heists in Canadian history.

articles.title: This heritage home may be paying the price of Toronto's electricity needs
articles.summary: A 145-year-old home near Kensington Market may soon be demolished — despite its status as a listed heritage site — after the building was reportedly bought earlier this year by Hydro One.

articles.title: Kaylee Hunter's late goal lifts AFC Toronto over Vancouver Rise
articles.summary: Kaylee Hunter scored in the 100th minute as AFC Toronto edged the visiting Vancouver Rise 2-1 on Sunday at York Lions Stadium.

articles.summary: Toronto police are searching for an unidentified man who is wanted in connection with a theft investigation that happened over the summer in North York. articles.title: Man, 25, faces multiple charges in ‘organized street racing’ investigation
articles.summary: A Toronto man is facing six charges in connection with what police describe as an “organized street racing” investigation in Peel Region. Earlier this year, detectives identified a suspect who was spotted operating a blue BMW 340i at several illegal street races. articles.title: On cusp of merger, ‘Digger bombs for Warner Bros., ‘Verity’ takes No. 1 at box office
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — On the cusp of the studio’s merger with Paramount, Warner Bros.’ “Digger” flopped in its opening weekend, handing Tom Cruise one of the worst debuts of his career and serving as a bitter final note for Warner Bros. as a standalone studio.

articles.title: Police investigate man's death in North York as homicide
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating a homicide after a man died in North York on Sunday morning.

articles.title: Man, 31, dead after being struck by vehicle in North York: Toronto police
articles.summary: A 31-year-old man has died after being struck by a driver in a vehicle in North York early Sunday morning, police said.

articles.title: Parrish vs. Crombie: As mayors past and present battle, will the drama drive voters to the polls?
articles.summary: In Mississauga, incumbent Mayor Carolyn Parrish is facing former mayor Bonnie Crombie. With a crowded field and a high-profile showdown at the top of the ticket, the central question hanging over the campaign is whether the drama will actually get residents to the polls.

articles.title: Grocery-style food bank aims to meet rising demand in Durham Region
articles.summary: Food bank visits in Durham Region have surged since the pandemic, according to Feed the Need Durham. The organization is turning to a grocery-style model it says can help make better use of food while giving people more choice. CBC’s Rochelle Raveendran has more.
